name: RMD-MP
savepath: This is another big update that brings new features such as mapping, new unique items requested by our Patreons, tons of skill changes and as always....bug fixes. Be sure to update your mod files along with D2RHUD to get the most out of your experience!

D2RHUD has also received a very large update, adding many new 'hardocde' features along with improved logic, performance and UI viewability. For RMD players especially, the new quest journal, D3 whirlwind, etc will be valuable additions to your adventure...enjoy!
